lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh milaai avagan vikanaa gun ravaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: If only I could meet the True Guru, the Primal Being. Discarding my faults and sins, I would chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dhiaai gurabaanee nit nit chavaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Continuously, continually, I chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurabaanee sad meethee laagee paap vikaar gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Gurbani always seems so sweet; I have eradicated the sins from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai rog gaiaa bhau bhaagaa sahaje sahaj milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The disease of egotism is gone, fear has left, and I am absorbed in celestial peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa sej gur sabad sukhaalee giaan tat kar bhogo ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the bed of my body has become cozy and beautiful, and I enjoy the essence of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sukh maane nit raleeaa naanak dhur sa(n)jogo ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, I continually enjoy peace and pleasure. O Nanak, this is my pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਕੁੜਮੁ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau kuRam kuRamaaee aaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is lovingly embellished with truth and contentment; her Father, the Guru, has come to engage her in marriage to her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kar mel gurabaanee gaavaaeeaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: Joining with the humble Saints, I sing Gurbani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee gur gaaee param gat paaee pa(n)ch mile sohaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Singing the Guru's Bani, I have obtained the supreme status; meeting with the Saints, the self-elect, I am blessed and adorned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaiaa karodh mamataa tan naathee paakha(n)d bharam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Anger and attachment have left my body and run away; I have eradicated hypocrisy and doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai peer gaee sukh paaiaa aarogat bhae sareeraa ||
lines.translation: The pain of egotism is gone, and I have found peace; my body has become healthy and free of disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee braham pachhaataa naanak gunee gaheeraa ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I have realized God, the ocean of virtue. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh vichhuRee door mahal na paae bal gaee bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is separated, far away from God; she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence, and she burns.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੂਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar mamataa koor kooR vihaajhe kooR laee bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: Egotism and falsehood are deep within her; deluded by falsehood, she deals only in falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kapat kamaavai mahaa dukh paavai vin satigur mag na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Practicing fraud and falsehood, she suffers terrible pain; without the True Guru, she does not find the way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਝੜ ਪੰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ujhaR pa(n)th bhramai gaavaaree khin khin dhake khaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The foolish soul-bride wanders along dismal pathways; each and every moment, she is bumped and pushed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape daiaa kare prabh daataa satigur purakh milaae ||
lines.translation: God, the Great Giver, shows His Mercy, and leads her to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke vichhuRe jan mele naanak sahaj subhaae ||3||
lines.translation: Those beings who have been separated for countless incarnations, O Nanak, are reunited with the Lord, with intuitive ease. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiaa lagan ganaai hiradai dhan omaaheeaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: Calculating the most auspicious moment, the Lord comes into the bride's home; her heart is filled with ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਆਣਿ ਪਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਵਾਚਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit paadhe aan patee bahi vaachaaeeaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Pandits and astrologers have come, to sit and consult the almanacs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤੀ ਵਾਚਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਜਬ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: patee vaachaaee man vajee vadhaaee jab saajan sune ghar aae ||
lines.translation: They have consulted the almanacs, and the bride's mind vibrates with bliss, when she hears that her Friend is coming into the home of her heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਹਿ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunee giaanee bahi mataa pakaaiaa phere tat divaae ||
lines.translation: The virtuous and wise men sat down and decided to perform the marriage immediately.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: var paaiaa purakh aga(n)m agochar sad navatan baal sakhaaee ||
lines.translation: She has found her Husband, the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Primal Lord, who is forever young; He is her Best Friend from her earliest childhood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kirapaa kar kai mele vichhuR kade na jaaee ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he has mercifully united the bride with Himself. She shall never be separated again. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿਲੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਪਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har pahilaRee laav paraviratee karam driRaaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: In the first round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord sets out His Instructions for performing the daily duties of married life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee brahamaa ved dharam driRahu paap tajaaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: Instead of the hymns of the Vedas to Brahma, embrace the righteous conduct of Dharma, and renounce sinful actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam driRahu har naam dhiaavahu simrit naam driRaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name; embrace and enshrine the contemplative remembrance of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur gur pooraa aaraadhahu sabh kilavikh paap gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Worship and adore the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, and all your sins shall be dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d hoaa vadabhaagee man har har meethaa laaiaa ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, celestial bliss is attained, and the Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the mind.
